EGY.note: States only that load shedding was not repeated; no outage count.
No share of people using the internet is stated.
Reports a 15% price rise on internet packages but gives no price.

facts.fact: Freedom House says Egyptian authorities blocked communications platforms in the coverage period as part of a crackdown on online mobilisation.

Freedom House says Egyptian authorities arrested people for joining political groups organised on social media, citing Amnesty International's July 2026 call to release dozens detained over a Gen Z online group.
